usageNotes: Executes the QEMU Guest Agent 'info' command on a running VM, returning metadata about the guest agent itself (version, supported commands, etc.). The VM must be running and have the QEMU Guest Agent installed and active; the call will fail if the agent is not responsive. Requires either VM.GuestAgent.Audit or VM.GuestAgent.Unrestricted on /vms/{vmid}.

examples.summary: Retrieve guest agent info for VM 101 on node pve1

tips: If the call returns an error like 'QEMU guest agent is not running', verify the agent service is started inside the guest OS (e.g., qemu-guest-agent.service on Linux).
The returned 'result' object typically lists the agent version and which guest-agent commands are supported — useful before calling less-common agent subcommands.
This is a synchronous GET; no UPID is returned. Results are available immediately in the response.
